A bond of 48% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Because the custody account is separate, an hostile operator cannot recycle one pool of capital across 103 aliases, and each one needs its own funded delta account. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
